## ScrollProgress.svelte

### `interface Props`

- `form` :: A bar along the edge of the viewport, or a ring that fills with the same progress.
- `position` :: Where a `bar` sits — the top or the bottom of the viewport. Ignored by the ring.
- `target` :: `page` tracks the document scroll; `element` tracks this component's passage through the viewport.
- `tone` :: The colour of the fill or ring.
- `children` :: Content whose passage is tracked when `target` is `element`.
